desc: Apps that help people drink less alcohol or quit drinking.

personas.name: Jessica
personas.bio: Jessica is a social media manager who enjoys going out with friends but often overdoes it with cocktails. She wants to be more mindful of her drinking without completely giving up her social life.
personas.motivation: Moderate - wants to be more intentional and avoid hangovers, but not quit.

personas.name: David
personas.bio: David is an engineer who meticulously tracks his data and wants a structured, evidence-based approach to moderate his alcohol intake. He's tech-savvy and appreciates clear metrics.
personas.motivation: High - committed to a data-driven moderation strategy for health and performance.

tasks.title: Establish a weekly drink plan
tasks.task: Go through the onboarding to set up an initial weekly drink goal and preferred drinking days.
tasks.success: The user has completed the initial setup process, defining their target number of drinks for the week and indicating which days they plan to drink.

tasks.title: Log a first drink
tasks.task: After setting up the plan, log one alcoholic drink to see how the tracking mechanism works.
tasks.success: The user has successfully recorded a drink (e.g., '1 beer') within the app, and the app reflects this in their daily/weekly count.
